pages.what: One list of everything found: the sources as horizontal tabs, state chips, one table; On the POA&M shows the plan's columns.
A finding's page: short title over the full sentence, next step as the one primary, plan and milestones, risk, control and component rows.
Control assessments, cyber tests and monitoring checks in one table; the kinds are horizontal tabs; one needs-attention card.
An assessment's page under the program menu: plan approval, objectives judged one by one (controls in a dropdown beside the search), requests, results, findings.
The register with state chips, and the ATT&CK techniques its risks name.
A risk's page: assessment, response, acceptance steps, the findings behind it, its techniques with what counters them.
A technique's page: the risks that name it, the countering controls with baseline standing and status; Link to a risk.
The decision in force; the package's parts with readiness; decisions; conditions closed in place; monitoring; who can open it.
The eye on a row: the same definition as the page, in the side panel; its way to the full record is the page.

walks.title: Judge an objective, plan it, publish

steps.do: Choose the Control assessments tab, then click Expanded control set assessment.
steps.see: Three rows in place; then the assessment's page with the program menu still there, Assessments marked.
steps.was: Cards on one page, a table on another; the campaign replaced the program menu.

steps.do: Open Objectives, choose AC-2(7) in the controls dropdown beside the search, press Judge on AC-02(07)(a).
steps.see: Four objectives with their methods; a form for that one objective.
steps.was: No determination could be recorded on one objective.

steps.do: Choose Other than satisfied, write the justification, Record determination; then Open finding in the toast.
steps.see: The objective names its finding; the finding's own page opens, marked Draft results, under Findings › Assessment findings.
steps.was: The row opened the control, which said it had no finding.

steps.do: On the finding's page: Create plan with a planned date, resources and a first milestone; then Add milestone.
steps.see: The plan and its milestones with their state are on the page; On the POA&M counts one more.
steps.was: Create POA&M item on a separate POA&M page.

steps.do: On the same page: Create risk, response Mitigate, with an owner; click the risk's row.
steps.see: The risk's page names the finding behind it; Risks lists it.
steps.was: Risk created from the issue's preview, then found again on Risks.

steps.do: Back on the finding, click the control's row AC-2(7).
steps.see: The control's page lists the finding and the risk under Findings and risks.

steps.do: Judge the other three Satisfied, then Publish results as D. Okafor.
steps.see: AC-2(7) reads Other than satisfied on Controls; the Overview's Assessed count rises; the finding leaves Draft results.
steps.was: Publishing opened a second record, an operational issue, for the same result.

walks.title: Work a finding, then the authorization

steps.do: In Needs attention click Operational issues 43.
steps.see: Findings opens on the Operational issues tab, Open chosen: exactly 43 rows.
steps.was: The count and the list it opened did not agree.

steps.do: Hover a row and press its eye; then click the row Session-table occupancy missing.
steps.see: The eye previews the finding beside the list; the click opens its page: plan with four milestones, risk, control, components.
steps.was: A click opened a side preview; the plan was on another page.

steps.do: Change planned date with a reason; Add milestone; Mark one reached; More, Deactivate with a reason.
steps.see: Each shows on the page at once and after a reload; Open counts one fewer and a Deactivated chip lists it.
steps.was: Change planned date lived on the POA&M page; a Deactivated tab.

steps.do: Choose On the POA&M; More, Export POA&M.
steps.see: The same list with planned date, milestones and resources; the file is saved.
steps.was: A POA&M page with its own records.

steps.do: Click T1078; click one of its risks; Link technique T1200.
steps.see: The technique's page lists its risks and countering controls; the risk's page gains the technique, and T1200 lists the risk.
steps.was: A Threats page, and a dialog that asked which risk.

steps.do: Read the package; click the POA&M part.
steps.see: Four parts, each Ready or Not ready from its record; the POA&M part counts what Findings counts and opens that list.
steps.was: A long page restating counts typed in markup.

steps.do: Close a condition; then Sharing, Share with a person.
steps.see: Conditions counts one fewer; the person is in Sharing's list.
steps.was: Conditions closed from a preview; sharing in the Package room.

shots.title: The POA&M is a view of Findings

shots.title: Assessments in one table

shots.title: A finding's page

open: fact('issues') now answers what Findings lists for the program on screen: 43 on a fresh WS-X90 (the issue raised for CVE-2024-6387 is listed once, under Vulnerabilities), so the Overview prints 43 and a condition reads '11 high issues open'. Lane F's own count was 44.
On a record page the next step's button is the header's one primary and the Next step line says why, without a button; in the preview the line keeps its button.

Lane S's cveFixed fact was not in the build: the walk stands in for it. A CVE fixed on every component it names leaves the open findings and shows under a Fixed chip; the operational issue behind CVE-2024-6387 is not closed in lane R's store.

The expanded campaign's objective results no longer touch PA.v2.chain: a control published there joins lane F's table PA.v3f.INC2 (mutated from outside, restored on reset), which lanes C, O and S read through lane F's status. V3 off shows v2's Assessments unchanged.
A determination short of satisfied opens an assessment finding and no operational issue; lane R's dialogs v3r-det and v3r-publish are unreachable.
An assessment finding whose control already has an operational issue shows that issue's plan ('Belongs to'); it is not counted again under On the POA&M.
The lists' search, chips and filters are kept when the reader comes back from a record's page, and across the source tabs; they are one view for every program (K 'fnd.view').
Vulnerabilities, open STIG rules, cyber tests, check runs, expanded-set requests, techniques and the package's recipients are parsed from the v2 pages that draw them.
Dropped from v19's issue preview: its Tickets card (the Jira sync) and Edit deadline. A cyber test's findings still open v2's v7a-cyf preview on a click (no page for that kind).

Risks and Authorization stay lighter than Findings and Assessments: no risk matrix, snapshots, package versions, access requests or access log. Import scan results and Export the package only record or toast.

Found by the re-walk, not fixed: the signed-in engineer chooses which assessor a determination is recorded as, so a finding reads "recorded as Nadia Fournier by Ingrid Solberg" (the prototype's way of acting as another person).
Found by the re-walk, not fixed: assessment rows have no eye; an assessment has a page and no preview.
A planned authorization decision (IATT or ATO of Increment 2) is recorded in one form on Authorization › Decisions; the lifecycle's step-by-step approval chain for it is not shown there.
